expression: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(el => el.childNodes.length === 1 && el.firstChild?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && el.textContent.trim()).map(el => ({ tag: el.tagName, className: el.className, text: el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40), size: getComputedStyle(el).fontSize })).filter(item => parseFloat(item.size) < 12); return { ok: false, items }; })()
